title: Mineeraria
description: A project aimed at creating modpack that guarantee fun
body:
# Welcome to Mineerraria
A modpack that combines the best mechanics of Minecraft and Terraria in one fun and dynamic adventure! If you like to explore huge worlds, fight epic bosses, level up your character and just have fun, then this build is for you!

What awaits you:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Terraria mechanics:

- Fishing, grappling hook, lunar events and unique dungeons.

- Mobs and weapons stylistically inspired by Terraria.

- Changing the difficulty of the world depending on events

</details>


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

RPG elements:

- Leveling up character skills: improve your skills in combat, resource extraction, construction and magic.

- Simple class system depending on the items used and the skills leveled up

![RPG stats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d65e91dc730187cd294bff4b1b3d3a514d515f82_0.webp)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Fun and dynamics:

Bright and memorable events that will not let you get bored.

A world full of surprises: from mysterious caves to epic battles with bosses.

Convenient and interesting mechanics that make the game even more exciting.

![a crocodile](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5c95ef825ac893b526c3674e461013ed463ca30.jpeg)
</details>


Why Mineerraria?
This is a build that will give you hours of fun and unforgettable adventures.

It is ideal for both single-player and co-op play with friends [LAN - UPnP].
